name: create_session
description: Create and start an independent peer session in this same workspace (no parent, no room membership). Take the provider, models, effort and limits from get_map {field: "providers"}; an account of the same CLI (for example custom-claude-2) is a separate subscription.

role.description: Id from list_roles; a native role must fit the provider (Claude roles also fit GLM).

agent.description: Legacy Claude role name; not with role.

worktree.description: Own git worktree; git projects only.

model.description: Model id; omit for the default, null clears the role default.

effort.description: Effort id; omit for the default, null clears the role default.

name: request_agent_switch
description: Ask @human to continue a session of this workspace on another provider (for example when its usage limit is near). Only the parent, a live lead or the owner of a room it takes part in, or the session itself may ask. It only creates a card: the switch happens after the human allows it.

session.description: Id of the session to continue, for example s-03.

model.description: Model id; omit for the default.

reason.description: Why, for the human: one or two sentences.

name: create_swarm
description: Start a research swarm: a queen session that splits a read-only task between drones and verifiers. Only for a big research task that does not fit one context; a narrow task is faster and cheaper with one agent. The result goes to you. Take provider, models and effort from get_map {field: "providers"}. Method: the research-swarm skill.

tag.description: Research, Audit, Debug or your own short text.

name: swarm_add
description: Queen only: add a drone (reads a slice) or a verifier (rechecks claims) to your swarm. Members are read-only, hand in with report done and are closed automatically.

agentRole.description: Role id from list_roles; default researcher (drone) or verifier.
